_comment: Job-approval tracking for currently-serving moderators, RCP-style (Approve/Disapprove), rendered as a 90-day rolling average on a donut per moderator. Empty for now -- no real approval polling has been logged. Shape once populated: { "moderatorKey": { "name": "...", "polls": [ {"pollster":"...","date":"YYYY-MM-DD","sample":N,"weight":1,"shares":{"approve":0.0,"disapprove":0.0}} ] } }. The homepage (index.html) checks this file first when off-cycle; if it's empty, it falls back to showing recent-race polling snapshots instead.
